[Verse 1: male rap, steady, drums and bass enter]
I built it out of weekends, out of favours, out of nerve
Drew the plans on a napkin, learned the rest on the curve
Put my name on the door and my savings in the floor
Told my mother it was working when I couldn't tell her more
Every year a little louder, every year a little thin
Kept on pouring in the hours where the cracks were getting in
And I held it, and I held it, till my hands forgot the rest
Then I watched it fold on a Tuesday, no alarm and no protest

[Chorus: raspy tenor sings, wall of guitars]
I gave it all I had
And I watched it fall
And for the longest time
I thought that that was all
But I'd do it the same
I'd lose it again
It turns out the trying
Is the part that I keep

[Verse 2: male rap, more personal, piano answers]
Same thing with the two of us, I'll say it while I can
I learned your coffee order, I learned your mother's plans
Showed up for the hard days, showed up for the worse
Read the books and did the work and said the sorry first
Still, you can do it right and watch it walk away
There isn't any scoreboard, there isn't any pay
I used to think that meant the whole thing was a lie
Now I think it means I'm someone who will try

[Chorus: raspy tenor sings, wall of guitars]

And for the longest time
I thought that that was all
But I'd do it the same
I'd lose it again

Nobody keeps the trophy
Nobody keeps the room
You only keep the reaching
So reach
So reach

[Final Chorus: both voices, heaviest, rap ad-libs between lines]

And for the longest time
I thought that that was all

I'd lose it again
